Were looking for top-tier talent and offer the flexibility you need to thrive and deliver lasting impact. Join us as we digitally connect the world and shape the future.

13996 | AI Specialist / Senior AI Engineer (P4 I)
Location Bangalore & Noida
Experience - 9-14 years

Mandatory Skills
Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Generative AI, Agentic AI, LLM, RAG, GraphRAG, AI Agents, LangGraph, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, Python, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Vector Database, MLOps, LLMOps, Databricks, NLP, Cloud Computing, AI Governance.

Role Summary
We are seeking a highly skilled Senior AI Engineer (P4-II) to design, develop, and deploy enterprise-scale Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, and Agentic AI solutions. The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in machine learning, large language models (LLMs), AI application engineering, cloud-native architectures, and MLOps practices.
This role requires hands-on technical leadership, the ability to drive projects independently, mentor junior engineers, and collaborate with business stakeholders to translate business problems into scalable AI solutions.
Key Responsibilities
AI Solution Development


Design, develop, and deploy AI/ML and Generative AI solutions for enterprise use cases.
Build and optimize Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) applications.
Develop Agentic AI workflows using frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, or equivalent.
Create scalable AI APIs and microservices using Python and modern backend frameworks.
Integrate AI capabilities into enterprise platforms and business applications.

Machine Learning & Data Science


Develop and deploy predictive models using supervised and unsupervised learning techniques.
Perform feature engineering, model training, evaluation, and optimization.
Build NLP, classification, recommendation, forecasting, and anomaly detection solutions.
Implement model monitoring and performance measurement frameworks.

Generative AI & LLM Engineering


Work with Azure OpenAI, OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, Llama, and other foundation models.
Design prompt engineering strategies and evaluation frameworks.
Implement advanced RAG, GraphRAG, memory systems, and agent collaboration patterns.
Fine-tune models when applicable and evaluate model quality, safety, and performance.
Drive Responsible AI practices and governance requirements.

Platform Engineering & MLOps


Design AI deployment pipelines using CI/CD best practices.
Implement MLOps and LLMOps frameworks for model lifecycle management.
Build observability, logging, tracing, and performance monitoring capabilities.
Optimize model costs and infrastructure utilization.
Work with Kubernetes, Docker, and cloud-native deployments.

Technical Leadership


Mentor junior AI engineers and data scientists.
Establish engineering standards, code quality practices, and reusable AI components.
Collaborate with architects, product owners, and business stakeholders.

Required Competencies

Ability to independently drive projects.
Technical mentoring capability.

Education


Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, AI, Machine Learning, Engineering, or related field.

Success Criteria


Deliver production-grade AI solutions with measurable business impact.
Drive adoption of Generative AI and Agentic AI across business functions.
Reduce operational effort through intelligent automation.


We are an equal opportunity employer committed to fair and ethical hiring practices. We do not charge any fees or accept any form of payment from candidates at any stage of the recruitment process. If anyone claims to offer employment opportunities in our company in exchange for money or any other benefit, please treat it as fraudulent and report it immediately.
